blocking_findings.summary: PBO selection and OOS rank ties depend on candidate IDs, so label renaming can change the promotion gate.
blocking_findings.successor_requirement: Use candidate-ID-invariant top-tie handling and OOS midranks with label-permutation tests.

blocking_findings.summary: The HAC overlay changes an effective session count from raw-return autocorrelation but does not estimate the Sharpe influence-series long-run variance.
blocking_findings.successor_requirement: Use a Bartlett/Newey-West long-run variance of the Sharpe influence series and gate on the minimum of IID and full-HAC probabilities.

blocking_findings.summary: R5M02 can pass without relative drawdown improvement, exposure-matched return noninferiority, or bounded opportunity cost versus R5M01.
blocking_findings.successor_requirement: Preregister and independently recompute all three relative risk-benefit gates.

blocking_findings.summary: The historical panel relies on provider adjustment=all without hash-bound raw/split/dividend reconciliation.
blocking_findings.successor_requirement: Bind provider panels and publish a deterministic split/dividend/all reconciliation before evaluation.
